reason: My broker app already lets me invest monthly for free, and I can ask ChatGPT a question for nothing. I'm not signing up for another monthly bill, at a price they won't even tell me yet, so a cartoon pet can make moves I can already make myself in two taps.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for my retirement money, and I'd be paying a subscription to trust a brand-new app with real dollars when it has only ever handled demo money.
would_change_my_mind: If the real-money account had no monthly fee at all, so I'd only pay the normal costs of a broker.
